description: AI teammate platform for Slack, email, meetings, research, integrations, and business workflows with approval controls and enterprise governance.

evidence.finding: Lindy says customers control what the service can access, can change or revoke permissions, and can set seat-level credit allocations within a workspace.
Lindy allows users to terminate accounts and request deletion of personal information, subject to limited legal and operational retention exceptions.
Lindy states that every action the service takes is logged so users can inspect what happened, when it happened, and why.
Lindy states that actions with outside impact wait for approval, including sending email, updating tickets, posting to channels, or publishing documents.
Lindy publishes individual pricing, includes a seven-day trial for new teammates joining through Slack, and provides shared credits across a team workspace.
Lindy states that users retain ownership of their Contributions and that those Contributions are not used to train AI models.
Lindy documents rights to request deletion, correction, restriction, and information about personal data, and says personal information is not sold to third parties.
Lindy advertises support for multiple frontier models, thousands of integrations, MCP connections, and explicit model choice rather than a single-model dependency.
Lindy says it does not create surprise overage bills: when a shared credit pool runs low, usage pauses and administrators can adjust allocations or plans.
Lindy is positioned as a Slack-native teammate that works alongside teams, with shared meeting libraries, team files, workspace context, and collaborative workflows.
Lindy combines automation with explicit approval gates for consequential actions, preserving a human decision point before external-impact work is executed.
Lindy lets users delegate work in natural language, offers a trial path, and provides ready-made assistant capabilities rather than requiring users to build a custom model stack.

limitations: This preliminary audit uses public Lindy primary-source documentation and has not been reviewed by Lindy.
Published product documentation is evidence of documented controls and policies, not proof of real-world outcomes for every deployment.
Humanity Score is a product-impact rating, not a regulatory, legal, safety, compliance, or government certification.
correction_policy: Source-backed factual corrections are welcome. Corrections change the audit only when the underlying evidence changes; payment cannot buy a higher score.
